label: Model asset directory
help: Prepare the pinned 4.52 GB CustomVoice snapshot. Run only reads verified local files; no automatic downloads.

label: Inference Python executable
help: Dedicated Qwen inference environment. Empty uses the application interpreter. This trusted executable runs locally; nothing is installed automatically.

label: Completed audio directory
help: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names; no overwrites or automatic deletion.

label: Built-in voice
help: One of the nine CustomVoice speakers. No reference recording or voice cloning required.

label: Speech language
help: Choose the text language or automatic detection. This does not translate the text.

label: Voice style instruction
help: Optional delivery guidance, up to 512 characters. This influences expression, not guaranteed voice identity or exact timing.

label: Inference device
help: CUDA is recommended for interactive use. CPU is explicit and slow; unavailable CUDA never silently falls back.

label: Completed file format
help: Complete Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz or PCM WAV at 24 kHz. No live audio stream or reference-voice upload.

label: Temperature
help: Official model sampling control. Higher values increase variation; not a voice identity selector.

label: Top-k sampling
help: Number of candidate audio tokens retained by the official sampler.

label: Numeric precision
help: Bfloat16 or float32. CUDA is explicit; unsupported devices never silently fall back to CPU.

label: CPU threads
help: Bound native CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.

label: Maximum audio duration (seconds)
help: Reject decoded audio exceeding this duration. The token budget also bounds generation; an absent EOS is refused rather than published as complete.

label: Maximum text characters
help: Reject oversized text. The model also enforces its own combined text/audio token window.

label: Total request deadline (seconds)
help: Verification, model loading, synthesis and publication must finish within this deadline; at most 240 seconds for managed execution.

label: Process address-space limit (MiB)
help: Optional Linux virtual-address ceiling: 0 disables it; otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA can reserve large virtual ranges. Not a RAM/VRAM reservation.

label: Required available RAM (MiB)
help: Refuse loading below this available-RAM threshold. Default 16 GiB; this check does not reserve memory or guarantee GPU capacity.

label: Pending request limit
help: Active Runtime only. Zero rejects new text while busy. Interrupt cancels the current job and clears earlier pending requests.

label: Top-p sampling
help: Nucleus-sampling probability for the main audio-code generator.

label: Repetition penalty
help: Main audio-code repetition penalty; not a guarantee against repeated speech.

label: Maximum generated tokens
help: Ceiling for the main code sequence; also capped from the audio-duration limit. Exhaustion without EOS produces no file.
